## Top level farmer decision flowchart
The overall farmer decision making process is shown below. Each farmer goes through this sequence each model time step. **Note** that the [aging and succession](05-farmer-aging-and-succession.qmd) step may also result in all of farm land use change. Click on the red text to find out what happens in each 'behavioural mode'.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
  A((START))
  B[Age farmers and<br>replace any that exit]
  C[Update income, costs, and<br>profit of holdings and farms]
  E[/For each<br>farmer.../]
  F[Debt-asset ratio DAR &larr;<br>current debt / <br> estimated value]
  G1{DAR &geq;<br>1.00 ?}
  G2{DAR &geq;<br>0.50 ?}
  G3{DAR &geq;<br>0.25 ?}
  H1[<span style='color:red;'>Exit<br>market]
  H2[<span style='color:red;'>Survival<br>mode</span>]
  H3[<span style='color:red;'>Constrained<br>mode</span>]
  H4[<span style='color:red;'>Optimisation<br>mode</span>]
  N[/More<br>farmers?/]
  Z((END))
  A --> B
  B --> C
  C --> E
  E --> F
  F --> G1
  G1 -->|No| G2
  G1 -->|Yes| H1
  G2 -->|No| G3
  G2 -->|Yes| H2
  G3 -->|No| H4
  G3 -->|Yes| H3
  H1 --> N
  H2 --> N
  H3 --> N
  H4 --> N
  N -->|Yes| E
  N -->|No| Z
  click H1 "09-exit-market-succession.html" "Click for details"
  click H2 "10-survival-mode.html" "Click for details"
  click H3 "11-constrained-mode.html" "Click for details"
  click H4 "12-optimisation-mode.html" "Click for details"
```

The 'break values' in the debt asset ratio that result in each behaviour are subject to change.
